final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* ---- bias: IREF (into ibias) -> nfet diode, mirrored to tail (0.8x) ----
MB   ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=2   L=1
MT   tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=1.6 L=1
* ---- stage 1: NMOS diff pair, PMOS mirror load ----
M1   n1    vinn  tail vss nfet W=3   L=0.15
M2   out1  vinp  tail vss nfet W=3   L=0.15
M3   n1    n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=1.4 L=0.18
M4   out1  n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=1.4 L=0.18
* ---- stage 2: push-pull gain stage (reduced bias branch, 1:2 nfet mirror) ----
M5   out2  out1  vdd  vdd pfet W=1.4 L=0.18
M7   n2    n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=0.7 L=0.18
M8   n2    n2    vss  vss nfet W=0.5 L=0.5
M6   out2  n2    vss  vss nfet W=1   L=0.5
* ---- inverter 1 ----
M9   out3  out2  vdd  vdd pfet W=0.84 L=0.15
M10  out3  out2  vss  vss nfet W=0.42 L=0.15
* ---- inverter 2 (drives CL = 50 fF) ----
M11  vout  out3  vdd  vdd pfet W=4   L=0.15
M12  vout  out3  vss  vss nfet W=2   L=0.15
.ends
